runtime.note: A built bundle of HTML, JS and CSS. Nothing executes on the host — it is served by whatever fronts it.

services.name: kgsm-api.service
services.why: the SPA is served same-origin by the API and every call it makes goes there
services.without: the bundle loads and shows its connect-a-host screen, and can do nothing else

units.note: Static files only — this project installs no unit.

paths.note: kgsm-api serves this directory. Its web root has to be pointable here, otherwise the two would contend for the same files and a package manager would call it a conflict.
